Data 360 Inspector

All-in-one toolkit for Salesforce Data Cloud — mapping canvas API names, field exports, Data Explorer with unlimited row export, Query Editor with full pagination, segment rule extraction, and data transform viewer. Page-aware: only activates on supported pages.

No install · works in any browser

Add the bookmarklet

  1. Show your bookmarks bar: ⌘⇧B on Mac  /  Ctrl⇧B on Windows.
  2. Drag this button to your bookmarks bar:   Data 360 Inspector
  3. Open any Data Cloud / Data 360 page in Salesforce and click the bookmark. A purple circle button appears in the bottom-right corner — click it to open the action menu.
  4. Click the bookmark again at any time to remove the tool.
The launcher sits in the bottom-right corner and never overlaps the Salesforce navigation. Click the purple circle button to expand the menu; click outside or click it again to collapse.

Features by page

🔁 DLO → DMO Mapping canvas

  • API Tooltip — hover any field to see its API name in a tooltip; click to copy to clipboard
  • Pin API names — pins all API names directly on the canvas at once; click Unpin names to clear
  • Export — full DLO→DMO mapping table filterable by DMO · Copy for Sheets or Download CSV

🌐 Data Stream & DLO detail pages

  • Export Fields — all fields with API name, label, data type, status, and key qualifier · Copy for Sheets or Download CSV

🌐 DMO detail pages

  • Export Fields — Fields tab (API name, type, mapped status, key qualifier) and Relationships tab (related objects and join fields) · Copy for Sheets or Download XLS

🏁 Segment pages

  • Export Rules — reads all segment conditions live from the canvas across Include, Exclude, and Rank & Limit tabs
  • Copy for Sheets — rich HTML table with group structure, AND/OR joiners, and sub-filters; pastes into Google Sheets or Excel with full formatting
  • Download HTML — saves a self-contained file that opens in Excel or Sheets with colours, groups, and a metadata footer

📊 Data Explorer (DLO / DMO / any Data Cloud object)

  • Columns — opens the Column Selector showing all available fields for the object, not just the handful SF shows by default
  • Available tab — search fields by name or label, sort A→Z / Z→A, select all / deselect all
  • Column Order tab — drag rows to reorder your selected columns before applying
  • Apply columns — applies your selection and loads data with a live query
  • Save / Restore / Clear set — persists your selection per object per org (90-day TTL)
  • True row count — shows the real total rows in the table (e.g. “Total: 117,204 rows”) regardless of how many are loaded in the view
  • Export All — fetches ALL rows from the server (up to 500k) as a paginated CSV download, with live progress. No row-count cap.
  • Download CSV (loaded rows) — instantly downloads the currently loaded rows as CSV
  • Filter bar — multi-condition filter (AND/OR) with type-aware controls (text/number/date/boolean). Runs server-side WHERE clause.
  • Hide empty columns — toggle to hide columns that have no data in the loaded rows
  • Edit SQL — opens SQL editor prepopulated with the current query; edit and re-run directly

🔎 Query Editor (SQL workspace)

  • Run & Export — run any highlighted SQL query and export the full result as CSV — bypasses Salesforce’s 2,000-row UI limit
  • Full pagination — automatically fetches all result pages (up to 500k rows) with a live progress bar
  • Smart selection — select with mouse OR Cmd+A / Ctrl+A; falls back to the full editor content when nothing is highlighted
  • Auto-retry dataspace — if the detected dataspace is wrong, automatically tries candidate dataspaces until one works
  • Meaningful errors — actionable messages for “denied authorization”, session expired, timeout, and connection issues

⚙️ Data Transform pages

  • View Definition — reads the full transform definition (batch = node graph, streaming = SQL) and renders it in a collapsible tree view
  • Copy JSON — copies the raw API response to clipboard for documentation or comparison
Extension vs Bookmarklet: The browser extension enables full pagination (fetches ALL rows via the documented /ssot/query-sql API). The bookmarklet uses Salesforce’s internal API and may be limited by session or internal caps. For large exports, the extension is recommended.

All modals are draggable (grab the header) and resizable (drag the bottom-right corner).

Privacy & safety

  • Runs entirely in your browser — no external servers, no third-party services.
  • Bookmarklet: uses only data the page has already loaded + Salesforce’s own internal APIs (same-origin).
  • Extension: calls Salesforce’s documented /ssot/query-sql API (read-only SELECT queries) using your existing session cookie. No data leaves your browser or your org.
  • Nothing is stored permanently — the tool disappears on page reload. Column selections use localStorage (per-org, 90-day TTL).
  • Read-only: it never creates, modifies, or deletes any Salesforce data.
